scope: can a minimal host-side component obtain the live conversation identity per tool call
question: R1 needs the caller's real identity. The MCP transport carries none, so the only candidate was code running inside the harness process, where the live session is observable.
method: installed a local plugin package into the isolated headless profile with `dsh plugin --profile headless add <path>`, pointed a probe overlay at it instead of the mcp-client, and drove one real conversation asking the model to call the tool it registers

answers.note_on_config: exporting name/inject/apply is enough; no zod import and no external dependency was needed

why_this_is_the_right_source: the value comes from the runtime's own execution context for that call, not from a model-supplied field, not from the overlay, not from a process id or command line. A conversation that borrows another conversation's overlay runs its own plugin instance and therefore reports its own session id.
what_it_does_not_yet_prove: that the value reaches the bridge - the provider currently registers its own probe tool, not the Tsunagou tools
that the bridge refuses a mismatch - no gate has been written yet
that agent connect/bootstrap still works with the provider in place
that Codex and OpenCode are unaffected
next_step: the provider proxies the Tsunagou bridge over stdio (initialize / tools/list / tools/call), registers every discovered tool while injecting the live session id into the arguments, and the bridge - gated to the deepseek adapter - compares its digest with the enrolled conversation digest and refuses on mismatch or absence
